title: Statistical optimal transport
tldr_zh: 统计侧系统讲义；第 1 章是最紧凑的严格预备（Brenier、循环单调、对偶三合一），其余归 T06/T05
tldr_en: Saint-Flour lecture notes on statistical OT: Chapter 1 is a compact rigorous primer (Brenier via cyclical monotonicity, duality); Chapters 2-8 cover rates and Wasserstein geometry.
key_numbers: Prop. 2.1: E W_1(mu_n,mu) <~ sqrt(d) * n^{-1/d} for d>=3, (log n/n)^{1/2} for d=2, n^{-1/2} for d=1, unimprovable (Sec. 2.1)
Thm 1.14: optimal coupling <=> graph of convex gradient <=> strong duality, potentials f=|x|^2-2phi, g=|y|^2-2phi* (Sec. 1.5.3)
Thm 1.6: W_p^p <= D^p d_TV on a ball of diameter D (Sec. 1.2)
